content: Prisma-to-Drizzle mapping pitfalls: Prisma DateTime maps to postgres timestamp(3) WITHOUT time zone by default (training-data knowledge, not re-verified; project audit M-6 mandates verifying live column types via pg_dump before authoring the Drizzle schema). Prisma cuid/uuid defaults are CLIENT-side generation - Drizzle generates nothing, so columns need explicit DB defaults or app-side generators, and bulk inserts silently break if ids are undefined. Defaults and indexes present in live DDL but absent from schema.prisma (db push history) get baked in or lost depending on which source is used. Confidence LOW (seam) - partially verified via orm.drizzle.team pull/push/generate/migrate semantics; timestamp mapping needs live-DB verification per audit M-3/M-6.
